callees.name: _analyze_project
callees.pre_condition: proj_dir is a non-empty string referring to a directory containing a valid Erlang project structure.
callees.post_condition: Returns an ErlangAnalysis object whose .functions, .edges, and .spans attributes are dicts populated with ELP analysis data for the Erlang source files under proj_dir. Raises an exception when the ELP backend is unavailable, proj_dir is not analyzable by ELP, or the analysis process encounters an unrecoverable error.
